generator.prompt: A lifelike head-and-shoulders portrait of a young late Roman soldier of the mid-3rd century AD, about twenty years old, as a living man, facing straight forward, symmetrical, with a calm neutral expression, the mouth closed and the eyes open looking straight ahead. Thick wavy dark-brown hair, clean-shaven, a round, friendly open face with full cheeks, a wide mouth and a short straight nose, a light warm complexion with natural skin detail. At the shoulders a grey, slightly rusty chainmail shirt of small interlocking iron rings over a red-brown wool tunic with a round neck. The figure ends at the upper chest with a flat, level cut. Realistic proportions, historically accurate. No helmet, no plinth or pedestal, no text or inscriptions, no modern objects, no fantasy elements.
